english.note: This is the all-purpose verb for expressing thanks or gratitude to a person or for something.
This is the all-purpose everyday choice when appreciating someone’s help, effort, or kindness.
Use this when acknowledging a favour by expressing thanks.

examples.english: I thank you for buying me lunch.
examples.jyutping: do1 ze6 nei5 bong1 ngo5 maai5 faan6

examples.english: I really appreciate you helping me move house.
examples.jyutping: zan1 hai6 do1 ze6 nei5 bong1 ngo5 bun1 uk1

examples.english: I acknowledge your help—thanks for helping me move house.
examples.jyutping: do1 ze6 nei5 bong1 ngo5 bun1 uk1
